findings.title: endOfDay returns the start of the next day
findings.body: The new implementation sets the date to `startOfDay(day) + 1 day`, which returns the start of the next day (midnight) instead of the end of the current day (23:59:59.999). This breaks the function's contract and likely causes downstream date comparisons to fail.

findings.title: Unused variable in endOfDay
findings.body: The new implementation uses `startOfDay(day)` to initialize `end`, but the variable `start` is no longer referenced. This reduces clarity and introduces a dead binding. Remove the unused variable or rename it to reflect its new role.

summary.problem: The endOfDay function now returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day, breaking its contract and likely causing downstream issues.
summary.done_well: The refactor uses startOfDay to avoid duplicating date normalization logic, improving maintainability.
